summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to conduct a comprehensive study on the mental, social, and developmental impacts of screen addiction among young men aged 12 to 25 and to report the findings to Congress.

scores.thoughts: The bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to conduct a study on the mental, social, and developmental impacts of screen addiction among young men. This directly relates to public health research and understanding health impacts, aligning with a more public healthcare approach by funding research through a government agency.

The bill mandates a study on screen addiction and its impacts, including social withdrawal and disengagement from civic participation. While not directly expanding welfare, understanding these issues could inform future social programs or interventions, thus tangentially relating to the social safety net.
